anti_cherry_pick_rule.selection: Within each slot, sort eligible official truth records by SHA256(stable_seed|slot_id|provider_item_id) and take the first required_count.
anti_cherry_pick_rule.freeze: The resulting provider item IDs and raw hashes are appended to a versioned truth manifest before any vendor scoring is inspected.
anti_cherry_pick_rule.replacement: A missing vendor match remains a miss; it is not replaced after vendor results are observed. Only an invalid official truth record may be replaced with a logged reason.

overseas_truth_basket.availability_policy: SEC acceptance time is not treated as exact public availability. Use the later of local first_seen_at and the preregistered conservative SEC lag until a measured dissemination lag is approved.

professional_news_sample.truth_anchor: Use the 96 A-share and 40 overseas official facts as event anchors; news vendors must retrieve matching coverage from 24 hours before through 72 hours after each official available_at.
professional_news_sample.missing_story_policy: A missing match is retained as zero coverage; do not substitute a later story.

sample_metrics_contract.coverage_start: earliest continuously available date in the sampled product
sample_metrics_contract.coverage_end: latest continuously available date in the sampled product
sample_metrics_contract.required_field_completeness: records with every required field / sampled records
sample_metrics_contract.timestamp_parse_success: timezone-aware parseable required timestamps / required timestamp values
sample_metrics_contract.entity_mapping_precision: correct mapped entities / all mapped entities in manual review
sample_metrics_contract.entity_mapping_recall: official truth entities recovered / all official truth entities in manual review
sample_metrics_contract.repeat_pull_hash_match_rate: unchanged immutable records with identical hashes / unchanged records across two pulls
sample_metrics_contract.future_available_at_violation_count: records exposed to a cutoff earlier than available_at
sample_metrics_contract.unlinked_revision_rate: revisions lacking a valid parent/original link / all revisions
sample_metrics_contract.event_case_coverage_rate: official truth anchors with at least one valid provider match / truth anchors

full713_capability_decision.pass: Every hard and timestamp gate passes, full713+warmup coverage is continuous, the frozen event set meets all numeric thresholds, and a frozen manifest replays with network disabled.
full713_capability_decision.conditional: No hard failure, but one or more contract, sample or independent-provider gates remain pending.
full713_capability_decision.fail: Any required timestamp/revision field is explicitly unavailable, future leakage occurs, history cannot cover the window, or local replay is not licensed.
